notes.title: FIRST EVER LIFESTREAM IN THE DEVELOPER'S LIFE
notes.content:
1. I'd play my game,
No one has ever seen me play my own game, this will be the first time ever

2. Talk about my game,
I'm the creator of the game, and I'd tell you everything there is to know about it

3. Trailer Showcase
I'll explain a little bit about the trailers. because they're not just trailers. they're interconnected with each other

4. Exclusive look at the 2nd Level
I'll show you an exclusive look at a level I'm working on to expand it. with the dialogues cut out, so there'd be no spoilers. just pure Gameplay
